# Premarket India

> A daily automated premarket intelligence report for Indian equity traders,
> generated at 09:00 IST (before the 09:15 NSE open) by Netlify scheduled
> functions. No accounts, no tracking. Not investment advice.

## What it publishes

- Decision framework (roles, not equal votes): GIFT Nifty's implied gap sets
  the opening bias (size aware: neutral under 0.15%, modest under 0.5%,
  strong at 0.5% or more); global cues (US close, live US futures, Asia) are
  context; the NSE pre open session (09:00 to 09:15 IST) cross confirms;
  advances and declines confirm the trend after the open; India VIX is a risk
  gauge against its own 1 year percentile, never a direction call. Conflicting
  signals are reported as conflicts, not forced conclusions.
- Implied open: GIFT Nifty vs NIFTY 50 previous close (with a futures basis caveat).
- Market context: crude oil (WTI and Brent), gold, USD INR, the US 10 year
  yield, Nikkei 225 and Hang Seng, each with a threshold based plain language
  read and a 5 day sparkline.
- Adaptive ensemble forecast (primary): a learned blend of TimesFM 2.5 and the
  live LSTM, w times TimesFM plus (1 minus w) times the bias corrected LSTM.
  The weight and bias are learned on a 250 session walk forward window
  (no leakage) and relearned daily from a live scorecard of resolved
  predictions. Component forecasts and provenance are shown with every report.
- LSTM forecast: a 3 layer LSTM (200 200 150, TensorFlow 1.6 semantics,
  trained on NIFTY 50 daily bars 2007 to 2026) predicting the next session's
  mid price and a 5 session fed back path, with a rolling 10 session backtest
  (RMSE and direction hit rate) recomputed on every run.
- TimesFM second opinion: Google's timesfm 2.5 (200M parameter) foundation
  model, zero shot, evaluated on the same walk forward window (offline
  artifact, stamped with its as of date).
- Per stock forecasts: TimesFM, zero shot, for 50 major symbols (US mega caps,
  sector leaders, SPY QQQ DIA ETFs, global ADRs, Indian ADRs), each with a 10
  session one session ahead backtest. Offline artifact at
  /assets/stock-forecasts.json, searchable and sortable on /stocks.html.
- Post open confirmation: a 09:20 IST pass records the actual open, price vs
  open, live breadth and live VIX, appended to the day's report.
- Data fallbacks: every source has an alternate where one exists, plus a last
  good cache with a per source freshness limit. Switching is automatic and the
  report discloses which state each source is in (live, cached with age, or
  degraded). Unavailable is always shown as unavailable, never guessed.
- Archive: every run is stored; up to 400 days of history.

## API

- GET /api/latest: newest report (JSON)
- GET /api/history: index of saved dates
- GET /api/report?date=YYYY-MM-DD&format=json|md|html: any archived report
- GET or POST /api/scan: trigger a scan (rate limited to 1 per 2 minutes)

## Per stock adaptive forecasts
Every stock forecast on /stocks.html comes from a gradient boosted tree model
trained on a decade of daily data (2016 to 2026) with market and sector
context (SPY, QQQ, VIX, sector ETFs). Each stock then learns daily from its
own results: per stock bias correction, recalibrated 80 percent prediction
band, and a blend weight with the TimesFM artifact. Predictions are resolved
against actual closes automatically at 09:10 IST Monday to Saturday. Honest
scoring: next session direction sits near 50 to 53 percent out of sample,
matching public research; band coverage is calibrated to 80 percent. The year
by year walk forward table is published on the page. Live data:
GET /api/stocks (JSON).

## News, earnings and event flags
A separate 08:40 IST cycle collects market headlines (CNBC, Google News; United
States and India), per stock headlines for all 50 symbols and the next ten days
of earnings dates (Nasdaq calendar). Headlines are keyword tagged (earnings,
merger, lawsuit, regulator, rates, inflation, geopolitics, election, cyber,
recall, accident) and daily per stock headline counts are recorded, so bursts
are flagged as heavy news. This layer is deliberately outside the forecast
models and is labeled as such: news is displayed for the reader to weigh.
Live data: GET /api/news (JSON).

## Framework track record
The daily opening bias call is checked against the actual open after the bell
and the rolling hit rate is displayed on the dashboard.

## Pages

- /: dashboard (today's report)
- /stocks.html: per stock TimesFM forecasts, searchable and sortable
- /search.html: one search box over every page and all 95 glossary terms (runs locally in the browser)
- /model.html: LSTM architecture, training, validation, TimesFM, the ensemble, limitations
- /methodology.html: checks, framework steps, sources, interpretation thresholds, FAQ
- /glossary.html: every term used on this site, defined in plain language, searchable, with cross links
- /eli5.html: the whole site explained in the simplest possible words
- /privacy.html: privacy policy (no cookies, no analytics)

## Writing policy

- All site copy follows plain language rules: no dashes as punctuation, no
  hyphenated compounds in prose, no filler or promotional words.
- Every number is measured and timestamped; accuracy claims come only from
  walk forward backtests; limitations are stated next to every forecast.
- Every technical term is either explained where it appears or linked to
  /glossary.html.
